body:
I checked this issue and I think just replace `pnwed` to `pwned` is okay.
I would like to explain my understanding and after that, I would like to create PR.

Regarding the [previous PR](https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/pull/2597/files#), there are 3 changes.

- path
- query
- params

### path

`page.path` is already sanitized without this change.
(Maybe already sanitized at browser level.)
Therefore test for sanitizing `page.path` should not fail without this change.
But I think we should add sanitizing process and tests because preventing XSS is very important and I'm not sure 100% ALL browser has such sanitizing process.

### query

The type of `page.query` is `URLSearchParams`.
And `URLSearchParams#toString` has sanitizing function.
Therefore this test case also should not fail without this change.
But again I think we should add this test also.

e.g.
```js
new URLSearchParams("key=</script><script>alert(3)</script>").toString()
-> 'key=%3C%2Fscript%3E%3Cscript%3Ealert%283%29%3C%2Fscript%3E'
```

### params

This is exactly the same as https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/issues/2596.
And `no xss via dynamic route path` test is failed if I revert the fix part.
And I checked that we can do XSS if I revert this change.

body:
The reason this didn't come up earlier is that the tests fail with a javascript error during page load when xss is attempted instead of the assertion error that would have not been triggered by the typo.

You cannot terminate the outer script block where we try to inject the xss script gracefully from inside the string literal. 
Example:  `"}}}});<script>xss here</script><script>/*` could work, but the initial " is escaped with \\" and at least 1 script error remains. This fails the page load of the testsuite and a timeout occurs.

The suite adds a "window.started" promise that is resolved on "sveltekit:start" event here:
https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/52c0f99e57b993e9749e05a7c4567c4c9e25ad34/packages/kit/test/test.js#L48

which is then awaited on here 
https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/52c0f99e57b993e9749e05a7c4567c4c9e25ad34/packages/kit/test/test.js#L205

(note: should it be a double await because page.evaluate itself returns a promise, so are we dealing with a promise of a promise here?)

and then throwing a timeout from here:
https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/52c0f99e57b993e9749e05a7c4567c4c9e25ad34/packages/kit/test/test.js#L209

I'm not familiar with the test setup in general so maybe someone who is has an idea how to fix this? Ideally the assertions work instead of producing a timeout. But i did verify the timeout only happens when xss is injected without the fix in place, so even if it is not the correct message the test does identify xss happening.

> (note: should it be a double await because page.evaluate itself returns a promise, so are we dealing with a promise of a promise here?)

I executed a promise of a promise on the playground.
At least below repl code, It seems like that we don't need double await.
(Please point it out if something is wrong.)

https://www.typescriptlang.org/play?#-TCZSo1D+6TE90ermeeQK9Haki+3SGFVuiBqqXqwhEflIAE9IIgmtB4EgiH4YGBRtY7JknHDcq9AlFMX4FNSoB8Ud8wX1iqDJpDxDCsszvPlMOzhLiGsIqTSUkA

By the way, `ambient.d.ts` defined `window.started` as boolean but actual type is `Promise<void>`.
We might want to fix that.

issue.title: [fix] Correct type definition of `window.started`
issue.body:
related: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/issues/2648

`ambient.d.ts` defines `window.started` as boolean.
But the actual type is `Promise<void>`.
So I corrected it out.

issue.title: Snyk reports code vulnerability in default startup project
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

When starting up a new project with `npm init svelte@next`, the new [Snyk Vulnerability Scanner extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=snyk-security.snyk-vulnerability-scanner) for VS Code reports a code vulnerability on lines 7 and 15 of `[uid].json.ts`: "Unsanitized input from an HTTP parameter [:7] flows [:7, :7, :7, :19, :27, :27] into fetch [:27], where it is used as an URL to perform a request. This may result in a Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability."

This obviously doesn't represent a security vulnerability in either Svelte or Sveltekit, and in truth I don't completely understand whether this is an actual vulnerability or just a potential one in the startup project code. However, I think we should encourage people to use security tools like Snyk, and part of that encouragement should be ensuring that the startup code either pass all the security tests or else include an ignore comment and explain why they don't apply.

### Reproduction

[The kit repository](https://github.com/sveltejs/kit) contains the issue in `/packages/create-svelte/templates/default`.

### Logs

_No response_

### System Info

```shell

    svelte: ^3.44.0 => 3.44.2
```


### Severity
